subject: dxf: merge OnFinished into RunSubtask (#58098)
summary: Reviewed the StepExecutor API change removing OnFinished and the corresponding DDL add-index/global-sort step executor updates. Subtask meta persistence still happens via BaseTaskExecutor.finishSubtask (taskTable.FinishSubtask) after RunSubtask returns nil, and the moved "onFinished" logic in DDL backfilling executors updates subtask.Meta before success as intended. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata/state transitions, or concurrency for the touched DDL/dxf paths; later upstream history shows continued evolution but no follow-up fix indicating a remaining high-severity defect in this change.
